affectionPlans.notes: PARKING: FOR APARTMENT, ONE BAY FOR EACH UNIT LESS THAN OR EQUAL TO 150 SQ.M GFA AND TWO BAYS FOR EACH UNIT EXCEEDING 150 SQ.M GFA; FOR RETAIL, ONE BAY FOR EACH 70 SQ.M OF RETAIL NET AREA. NOC FROM DUBAI MUNICIPALITY COASTAL ZONE AND WATERWAYS MANAGEMENT SECTION TO BE OBTAINED. BUILDING ELEVATIONS SHOULD FOLLOW THE ARCHITECTURAL THEME OF JADDAF WATERFRONT. RETAIL IS RESTRICTED ON THE GROUND AND FIRST FLOOR FACING ROADS AND WALKWAYS.
